hero.title: Everything you need to steer delivery with confidence.

integrations.title: Deep integrations

alerts.title: Proactive alerts

exports.title: Audit-ready exports

faq.title: Pricing & packaging FAQ

seatAddons.question: How are seats counted?
seatAddons.answer: Anyone who appears on a squad dashboard or receives automated digests consumes a seat. Service accounts are free.

annualCommit.question: Do you offer multi-year agreements?
annualCommit.answer: Yes. Enterprise customers can lock in roadmap commitments, premium support tiers, and fixed unit pricing across a 24-36 month term.

sso.question: When is SSO included?
sso.answer: SSO via SAML or OIDC ships by default on Enterprise and can be added to Growth for qualified security reviews.
